blockCookies.title: Block Cookie Walls
blockCookies.description: Enforce automatic rejection and suppression of cookie consent banners.

blockNewsletters.title: Block Newsletter Popups
blockNewsletters.description: Enforce suppression of lead-generation dialogs and newsletter popups.

blockChats.title: Block Customer Chat Widgets
blockChats.description: Enforce hiding persistent live chat bubble widgets.

restoreScroll.title: Restore Scroll Locks
restoreScroll.description: Enforce automatic clearing of document viewport overflow locks.

stopAutoplay.title: Pause Autoplay Media
stopAutoplay.description: Enforce pausing unprompted background HTML5 video playback.

blockSurveys.title: Block Surveys
blockSurveys.description: Enforce suppression of intrusive feedback and survey dialogs.

unblurContent.title: Unblur Soft Paywalls
unblurContent.description: Enforce removal of CSS blur filters and height restrictions on articles.

unlockCopy.title: Unlock Copy & Context Menus
unlockCopy.description: Enforce restoration of right-click context menus and text selection.

cleanUrls.title: Clean Tracking URLs
cleanUrls.description: Enforce removal of tracking query parameters on copy.

blockAntiAdblock.title: Block Anti-Adblock Walls
blockAntiAdblock.description: Enforce neutralization of Admiral and adblock detection modals.

blockLoginWalls.title: Block Forced Login Walls
blockLoginWalls.description: Enforce neutralization of forced registration walls on Quora, Glassdoor, and Pinterest.

reclaimViewport.title: Viewport Reclaim Engine
reclaimViewport.description: Enforce compact sticky headers and un-sticking of floating promotional ribbons.

whitelistedDomains.title: Corporate Whitelisted Domains
whitelistedDomains.description: List of domains exempt from decluttering (e.g. internal intranets).

forcedLockedSettings.title: Prohibited User Modification Keys
forcedLockedSettings.description: List of settings that end-users are strictly prohibited from changing.
